description: Versioned deterministic baseline for inspectable GenLayer consensus-safety properties. MEETS_BASELINE requires retrieved source provenance, a recognizable GenLayer contract, and a public-write-reachable consensus path. Passing is not formal verification or a security guarantee.

rules.deterministic_core: Require an exact canonical HTTPS raw GitHub URL pinned to a lowercase full commit and an exact canonical SHA-256 match. Submitted bytes remain explicitly unverified source provenance.
Require a recognizable gl.Contract with a public entrypoint, at least one bounded public-write-reachable run_nondet_unsafe path, and independent validator evaluation.
Require a reachable validator to fail closed on non-gl.vm.Return outcomes before using calldata.
Require a preceding fail-closed enum or range rejection before model-derived state writes.
Trace bounded public value-transfer paths, including same-class helpers, to preceding caller-derived authority guards.
Reject caller-controlled or nondeterministic transfer amounts and unguarded caller-controlled recipients on bounded public call paths.
Check that validators independently re-observe external evidence.
Detect untrusted source content entering prompts without explicit evidence framing.
Require fail-closed HTTPS raw GitHub host, URL length, and applicable duplicate constraints before web observation.
Reject state writes reachable before consensus, including through same-class helpers, and state writes inside consensus callbacks.
Require preceding fail-closed terminal guards and terminal state writes on bounded non-balance settlement paths.

status_meanings.FAIL: At least one implemented rule found a policy violation. Other rules may remain explicitly unverifiable.
status_meanings.MEETS_BASELINE: The independently retrieved GenLayer contract revision has a public consensus path and meets the implemented rules only; this is not formal verification or a security guarantee.
status_meanings.UNVERIFIABLE: The analyzer could not establish source provenance, recognizable GenLayer contract structure, a public consensus path, or another fact required to evaluate a rule within deterministic work limits.
status_meanings.WARN: No implemented rule failed, but at least one implemented rule produced a bounded warning.
